description: Declare a Cube semantic-layer measure or dimension as an external Dagster asset. Pair with cube_query_asset.

measure_name.description: Cube measure name (e.g. 'Orders.count', 'Orders.totalAmount'). Set this OR dimension_name.
measure_name.label: Measure Name

dimension_name.description: Cube dimension name (e.g. 'Orders.status'). Set this OR measure_name.
dimension_name.label: Dimension Name

metric_type.description: Cube type (count / sum / avg / string / time / number / boolean). Surfaced as metadata.
metric_type.label: Metric Type

cube_playground_url.description: Cube Playground URL — clickable link in the catalog to inspect the metric interactively.
cube_playground_url.label: Cube Playground URL

cube_docs_url.description: URL to the metric's docs / schema file (GitHub / internal wiki).
cube_docs_url.label: Cube Docs URL
